thread:
incident-bot: ALERT  model-quality  summarizer-xl  elevated omission/regression signal

incident-bot: Detector: eval-suite configured for summarizer-xl flagged a large increase in omitted clauses and PII non-redaction failures for /summarize endpoints. Impact: potential sensitive data exposure for a small subset of customers. Severity: P1 (safety-sensitive). Trigger time: 09:42 UTC.

nora_oncall: paging in. is this an error spike or quality-only? any 5xxs?

sam_runtime: seeing no HTTP 5xx spike. errors stable. this is quality only. classifier for PII-detection tripped on ~22 requests flagged by downstream monitors.

priya_ml: quick reproduction run against golden set shows summarizer-xl returns truncated summaries that omit critical clauses and sometimes leaves raw PII tokens unmasked when the input has long legal disclaimers. baseline model summarizer-latest had correct redaction.

emma_cust_success: notified two affected customers already (LexLedger and Accountrix). LexLedger flagged a leaked SSN fragment in a condensed note. They sent the transcript and sample request.

nora_oncall: immediate mitigation options: (A) pin affected customer routes to summarizer-latest (safe) (B) rollback summarizer-xl deployment (C) apply emergency safety filter at proxy layer to catch PII tokens.

priya_ml: I recommend layered approach: 1) pin for affected customers 2) enable proxy filter temporarily (ops_bot has a heuristic redaction lambda) 3) investigate model compile/quantization differences that may have impacted attention chunking.

nora_oncall: executing pins now for LexLedger & Accountrix.

nora_oncall: rictl commands:

```
# pin both customers to the last-stable summarizer
rictl routes pin --customer LexLedger --route /summarize --model summarizer-latest --reason "PII redaction regression"
rictl routes pin --customer Accountrix --route /summarize --model summarizer-latest --duration 48h
```

incident-bot: ACTION  pins applied for LexLedger & Accountrix at 09:49 UTC by nora_oncall. Proxy filter toggled by ops_bot.

ops_bot: SAFETY FILTER  proxylambda-redact enabled for /summarize in eu-west1 and us-east1 with aggressive PII regex. Note: may alter outputs; set to monitor-only after 15m if no new hits.

sam_runtime: queued rollback for eu-west1 if pins + proxy don't contain regression within 10m. rollback plan:

```
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/summarizer-xl --to-revision=stable-20240510
rictl routes verify --region eu-west1 --model summarizer-latest
```

priya_ml: collecting model artifacts. early suspicion: new tokenizer patch changed bytepair merges -> changed positional alignment on long inputs. also a quantization pass added per-layer folding. reproducing locally now.

marta_pm: craft customer-facing note (short):

"Hi LexLedger,

We detected a regression in our recently deployed summarization model (summarizer-xl) that may have affected redaction/omission on long legal texts. We have pinned your traffic to the previous stable model and enabled an additional proxy safety filter. You should no longer see sensitive fragments. We are investigating root cause and will follow up with a post-incident report and remediation plan. Immediate contact: emma@redwood.com"

emma_cust_success: sending to LexLedger now, including the transcript they provided and noting pins at 09:49 UTC.

incident-bot: METRICS  pii-redaction-fail-rate (eu-west1): baseline 0.02% -> spike 0.9% at 09:42 UTC; pinned routes down to 0.03% by 09:52 UTC.

nora_oncall: quick verification against the 4 customer examples LexLedger provided shows pinned route returns properly redacted summaries and no omission of mandatory clauses.

priya_ml: reproduction note: when truncation + quantization interact with the tokenizer mapping on >4096 tokens, attention windows misalign and the redaction head can miss spans. adding instrumentation now to capture attention span alignment and tokenizer offsets.

sam_runtime: handoff note: I'll take oncall at 10:05 UTC. if proxy filter hits >10 in 15m or pinned routes show regression, escalate to eng-runtime and consider immediate rollback.

marta_pm: proposed status page update:

"Investigating: A model update introduced a redaction/omission regression in summarizer-xl impacting a small number of customers. Mitigation: affected routes have been pinned to a stable model and a proxy safety filter deployed. Engineers are investigating root cause. No service downtime. Next update in 30 minutes."

nora_oncall: posted to ops.status.redwood.com/incidents/SUM-3321 and linked in customer notes.

emma_cust_success: LexLedger replied and asked for SLA credit and confirmation that exports and logs with exposed fragments will be purged. I told them we'll include remediation steps in the postmortem and will coordinate security review.

priya_ml: urgent action item: add automated pre-release hazard check for redaction tasks with long-input tokenization parity tests. Also, add a canary gate: if redaction-classifier >0.5% in canary -> block rollout.

sam_runtime: added runbook snippet to #oncall-handoff with rollback steps and where to find the proxy toggle.

ops_bot: REMINDER  Safety filter will auto-relax to monitor-only at 10:07 UTC unless manually extended.

nora_oncall: handing off to sam at 10:05 UTC. please monitor classifier and the proxy filter dashboard. escalate if any PII leakage trace.

marta_pm: assigning postmortem owners: priya_ml (technical RCA) + emma_cust_success (customer impact). target postmortem draft in 48h and full report in 72h.

priya_ml: starting artifact collection: tokenizer diffs, quantization logs, model compile flags, canary rollout logs, examples provided by customers. will attach to postmortem doc.

incident-bot: UPDATE  mitigations holding for pinned traffic. Next update in 30m or on new findings.

emma_cust_success: LexLedger confirmed mitigation working and requested a walk-through of changes. scheduling a 1:1 with them for tomorrow.

nora_oncall: final: no 5xxs, impact limited to data quality and safety. pins + proxy worked. please add recommended CI gate for redaction and a tokenizer parity test as high priority in postmortem actions.
